notes.title: Big F. Update!
notes.content:
Added music composed by TeknoAxe.

New weapon added: BFG.

Minor fixes implemented.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed weapon switching between levels in Enter the Void.
Fixed the exit menu for Exit the Void.

notes.title: Enter the Void
notes.content:
Check out the new game mode - originally planned as the main mode for the game!

[list]
[*] Navigate through small, randomized levels.

[*] Every few levels, you reach a tram stop - a checkpoint where you can save your progress, return to the hub, or continue to the next level at your own risk.

[*] Each tram stop you pass increases the number of enemies in subsequent levels and grants a money bonus.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/94e19813874e30ce5b76fd398203940061c4be29.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/9b7806ce1b3eec6a9c053d1ee649f5ed9e2f9853.png[/img]

New, awesome bunny suit added!

notes.title: SECOND AMENDMENT UPDATE
notes.content:
[b]Dual Weapon Equipping[/b] You can now equip two weapons and switch between them during gameplay. Note: Switching is disabled during a weapon's cooldown animation.


[b]Weapon Charging Mechanic[/b] Certain weapons now feature a charging ability. Hold the fire button to load additional rockets, fire a larger blob from the Bio Rifle, or charge the Shock Rifle.
[b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/535eb40619f80c64ecff13362c8775e893338014.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/ebd7706284bc426fb449f561e0b6c302343b2d8e.gif[/img]


Minigun[/b] The Minigun has been added to the Downtown and Factory levels. The longer you hold the fire button, the faster it shoots.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/99e66bdd3f387c2af1295229fd9a9bf4da26aacc.gif[/img]

[b]Shock Rifle[/b] Added the Shock Rifle, a powerful but slow-firing weapon that requires charging before each shot.

[b]
Enhanced Enemy Wave Generation.
[/b]

[b]Minor Bug Fixes[/b] Resolved several issues, including a deadlock caused by dying in the hub level, along with other minor bugs.

notes.title: DEEPSTATE FORGE
notes.content:
[h1]NEW LEVEL: DEEPSTATE FORGE (Factory)[/h1]

Venture into the [b]Deepstate Forge[/b], an industrial hellhole buried beneath a rotting city.
This labyrinth of glowing conduits and forbidden tech is where rogue scientists cook up nightmares, splicing alien gear with illegal AI to spawn bio-synthetic monstrosities. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/e8c3859a1890dc3f1de16b2526656add2fd2306d.gif[/img]


[h1]NEW ENEMY: NEMESIS[/h1]

Meet [b]NEMESIS[/b], the sassiest, deadliest robot you’ll ever regret crossing. This female-shaped killing machine stalks the [b]Deepstate Forge[/b], unleashing hell with her leg-driven melee assaults. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/46664d2f9e0cb385b382b35130c4182996cb1f45.gif[/img]

notes.title: ANNOUNCER UPDATE

notes.title: Important Notice!
notes.content:
There’s a [b]bug [/b]in the hub that currently prevents level selection. 

I’m aware of this issue, and it will be resolved in the next update.

Workaround for now:[b] Visit the shop first[/b] - this will unlock the level select menu for some reason.

notes.title: Gameplay evolution
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/4e81b81ef65e81dc6062ce1ccc30894723cfd366.gif[/img]

[h3]
 I've overhauled the gameplay to make it faster and more dynamic! [/h3]
[h3]
Now, you’ll battle endless waves of enemies, evacuate to secure your loot, and destroy enemy power cores to unlock exciting bonuses like auto-turrets, allied bots, extra lives, and more. [/h3]

[h3]This update also introduces new bugs. [/h3]


[h2] I’m committed to keep improving the game and adding fresh content, so stay tuned.[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45383065/db330d444c025ec9f199ea2333686b527a0b842a.gif[/img]

notes.title: New Content: Hoverboarding Madness!
notes.content:
A new mission has been added where you can take a break from the grind and ride your hoverboard. Conquer the slopes, bugs, and some questionable game design! Have fun!

Also, I’ve reworked the visuals to make them brighter, and I added a crappy outline shader for the ultimate experience!

Rock like it’s 1999!!!

notes.title: New Weapon: Disc Saw Gun! 🔥⚙️
notes.content: Get ready to unleash chaos with the latest addition to your arsenal—the Disc Saw Gun! This bad boy fires high-speed circular saw blades that ricochet off walls and enemies, creating a whirlwind of destruction. But beware—what goes around might just come around! Watch your aim, or you might end up on the wrong side of your own saw blades.
